verdict.rationale: The GitHub README directly claims the exact capability: "Multi-URL Configuration: Different strategies for different URL patterns in one batch," and the docs separately note parallel crawling for batch workloads. The support rests on a single one-line feature claim, with no depth on how patterns are matched or configs assigned. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of the pattern-matching and per-URL config API, and independent or hands-on corroboration that per-pattern configs work in practice.
